_comment_blockIdentifier1: a string embedded in the block to be mined. Used to identify the pool in Insight etc etc.
_comment_blockIdentifire2: If this value equals null string, website.stratumHost in 'config.json' is used.

paymentProcessing._comment_minConf: Coinbase outputs mature after 100 blocks on Bitcoin; 101 keeps a one-block margin.
paymentProcessing._comment_paymentMode: prop, pplnt, pplns, solo, pps, dpps, fpps, ppsplus, smpps, esmpps. solo = the worker that finds the block takes the whole reward (the home-ASIC / Bitaxe model); use pplns or prop for a shared pool.
paymentProcessing._comment_pps: paymentMode=pps only (share-based; the pool fronts block-find variance from a pre-funded float - see docs/payment-schemes.md). blockReward = current block subsidy in coins (0 DISABLES accrual; set it from your daemon's getblocktemplate coinbasevalue or getblocksubsidy); minFloat = kill-switch float floor, operator-tunable; feePercent = pool cut taken off each share; accrualInterval = seconds (min 10).
paymentProcessing._comment_dpps: paymentMode=dpps only (dynamic PPS; the per-share rate auto-throttles on the pool's realized luck, floored at rateMin and capped at full PPS - see docs/payment-schemes.md section 5). blockReward as in pps; targetMargin = solvency cushion taken off the rate (0.02 = 2%); rateMin = floor on the per-share rate vs full PPS; smoothingWindow = accrual cycles over which realized luck is EMA-smoothed; minFloat / accrualInterval as in pps.
paymentProcessing._comment_fpps: paymentMode=fpps only (Full PPS; share-based - same float/kill-switch risk as pps). Pays a per-share rate over (blockReward + smoothed average tx fee), so miners get an even slice of expected fees regardless of which block carried them. blockReward = block subsidy in coins; feePercent = pool cut; minFloat = kill-switch floor; feeWindow = blocks over which the avg tx fee is EMA-smoothed; accrualInterval = seconds (min 10). See docs/payment-schemes.md.
paymentProcessing._comment_ppsplus: paymentMode=ppsplus only (PPS+; the block SUBSIDY is paid via PPS accrual from the float, the TX-FEE portion of each block is distributed PPLNS-style to recent shares). blockReward = block subsidy in coins (kept in the wallet to back accrual); feePercent = pool cut on the subsidy; minFloat = kill-switch floor; n = fee window as a multiple of network difficulty; maxLogLength = cap on the rolling share log in entries; accrualInterval = seconds (min 10). See docs/payment-schemes.md.
paymentProcessing._comment_smpps: paymentMode=smpps only (Shared Maximum PPS; bounded pool risk). Miners accrue PPS per share into an owed ledger, but balances are only released up to the pool's realized income (matured block rewards) - so the pool can carry deferred debt but never an unbacked liability. smpps pays OLDEST debt first (FIFO). blockReward = block subsidy in coins; feePercent = pool cut; minFloat = kill-switch floor; accrualInterval = seconds (min 10). See docs/payment-schemes.md.
paymentProcessing._comment_esmpps: paymentMode=esmpps only (Equalized SMPPS; same bounded-risk income cap as smpps, but when underfunded every miner gets the SAME fraction of their owed instead of oldest-first). Fields as in smpps. See docs/payment-schemes.md.
paymentProcessing._comment_pplns: paymentMode=pplns only (pay-per-last-N-shares; block-based, no float/liability - see docs/payment-schemes.md). Each matured block is shared among the contributors to the last N shares before it, where the window is a multiple of the network difficulty (windowDiff = n * networkDiff) and slides across round boundaries. n = window size as a multiple of network difficulty; maxLogLength = cap on the rolling share log in entries (must comfortably exceed the shares the window covers).

_comment_ports: sha256 share difficulty 1 = 2^32 hashes. A port's diff is the starting point and varDiff retargets each miner toward targetTime seconds per share within [minDiff, maxDiff]: diff = hashrate x targetTime / 2^32. Size ports for 2026 hardware: a 1-2 TH/s home ASIC (Bitaxe, NerdQAxe) settles near 4096; a 200-300 TH/s S21/M60-class machine near 1000000; a farm proxy that funnels many machines through one connection needs the 3334 ceiling or higher. Every current ASIC speaks mining.configure version-rolling (see version_mask in the coin file) and most also send mining.suggest_difficulty, which the pool honours.

3334._comment: Hashboard ASICs (S19 ... S23, M50 ... M70) and farm proxies.

_comment_poolId: use it for region identification: eu, us, asia or keep default if you have one stratum instance for one coin
_comment_daemons: Bitcoin Core 25+ with server=1 and rpcuser/rpcpassword (or rpcauth) in bitcoin.conf; the wallet that owns `address` must be loaded. getblocktemplate needs a synced node with peers.
_comment_p2p: Block notifications over the P2P port (8333). Bitcoin Core 28+ still accepts v1 transport peers; keep disableTransactions true so the node does not relay the mempool to the pool.
